title: Duplicate mention notifications for tag+DM recipients
description: inbox.rs:1000-1061,1082-1139. When handling a Create activity for a 'direct' visibility Note, the code first processes tags (lines 1001-1061) creating mention notifications for local users found in Mention tags, then processes to/cc recipients (lines 1082-1139) also creating mention notifications. The DM path at line 1091 checks mention_notification_exists to avoid duplicates, but insert_remote_mention at line 1088 is called without dedup — if the same persona was already mentioned via the tag array, a duplicate mention row is inserted (unless there's a unique constraint). The notification dedup on line 1091 prevents double notifications, but the duplicate mention row could cause issues in mention-count queries.
